row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (no public pricing; single SKU priced per cloud workload)
row.evidence: Okta's catalogue lists an Orca Security app with SAML and SCIM (Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push), but Orca's own public pages do not document SCIM and Orca publishes no plans or prices (a single SKU priced on the number of cloud workloads).
row.notes: Quote-only: Orca publishes no plan table or prices; its pricing post describes one all-inclusive SKU priced on the number of cloud workloads protected. The only SCIM evidence is the Okta Integration Network app (SAML and SCIM ticked; Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push ticked), so under rule 6a the row stays unknown rather than gated. Orca's documentation (docs.orcasecurity.io) redirects to a customer sign-in region picker, and orca.security/pricing/ and the Okta partner page loop on a redirect, so plan gates, SCIM endpoint details and any user-management API could not be read. Not in the Microsoft Entra gallery. If Orca's docs confirm SCIM, the single-SKU model suggests it would not be priced separately, but that is not stated publicly. New row.

scim.notes: Okta OIN shows SCIM provisioning (c3, c4), but Orca's own documentation is behind a customer sign-in, so no vendor-documented SCIM facts are recorded.

user_api.notes: Orca has an API (product docs behind customer sign-in); whether it covers user management is not publicly documented.

okta.notes: OIN page markup ticks SAML and SCIM, and Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push (Group Linking, Sync Password, Schema Discovery not ticked). Builder not stated.

entra.notes: Not listed: no Orca entry in the Entra SaaS app tutorials index (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/saas-apps/toc.json).

fallbacks.notes: Product documentation sits behind the customer sign-in region picker.
